mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material (material_code, material_name, specification, drawing_no, material_type, unit, material_category, validity_from_date, validity_to_date, source, erp_sync_time, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64),#{materialCode}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(256),#{materialName}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(512),#{specification}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(128),#{drawingNo}), ISNULL(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{materialType}), N''), N'零件'), ISNULL(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),#{unit}), N''), N'个'), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{materialCategory}), CONVERT(DATE, NULLIF(#{validityFromDate}, ''), 23), CONVERT(DATE, NULLIF(#{validityToDate}, ''), 23), ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{source}), N'MANUAL'), #{erpSyncTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdBy}, GETDATE(), GETDATE())

INSERT INTO material (material_code, material_name, specification, drawing_no, material_type, unit, material_category, validity_from_date, validity_to_date, source, erp_sync_time, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64),#{item.materialCode}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(256),#{item.materialName}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(512),#{item.specification}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(128),#{item.drawingNo}), ISNULL(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{item.materialType}), N''), N'零件'), ISNULL(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),#{item.unit}), N''), N'个'), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{item.materialCategory}), CONVERT(DATE, NULLIF(#{item.validityFromDate}, ''), 23), CONVERT(DATE, NULLIF(#{item.validityToDate}, ''), 23), ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{item.source}), N'MANUAL'), #{item.erpSyncTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.createdBy}, GETDATE(), GETDATE())
mapper.update: UPDATE material SET material_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(256), #{materialName}), N''), material_name), specification = COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(512), #{specification}), N''), specification), material_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), #{materialType}), N''), material_type), unit = COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), #{unit}), 16), N''), unit), material_category = COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32), #{materialCategory}), N''), material_category), validity_from_date = CONVERT(DATE, NULLIF(#{validityFromDate}, ''), 23), validity_to_date = CONVERT(DATE, NULLIF(#{validityToDate}, ''), 23), source = N'ERP', erp_sync_time = GETDATE(), updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE material_code = #{materialCode}
UPDATE material SET erp_have_drawing = #{flag}, erp_sync_time = GETDATE(), updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE material_code = #{code}
mapper.sql: SELECT m.*, CASE WHEN dpdf.pdf_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_drawing, CASE WHEN d3d.d3d_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_3d, CASE WHEN deng.deng_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_engineering, d.min_created_at AS drawing_add_date, d.max_created_at AS drawing_update_date, ISNULL(d.drawing_count, 0) AS drawing_count FROM material m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, COUNT(*) AS drawing_count, MIN(created_at) AS min_created_at, MAX(created_at) AS max_created_at FROM drawing GROUP BY material_id ) d ON m.id = d.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, COUNT(*) AS pdf_count FROM drawing WHERE LOWER(file_format) = 'pdf' GROUP BY material_id ) dpdf ON m.id = dpdf.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, COUNT(*) AS d3d_count FROM drawing WHERE LOWER(file_format) IN ('sldprt', 'sldasm') GROUP BY material_id ) d3d ON m.id = d3d.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, COUNT(*) AS deng_count FROM drawing WHERE LOWER(file_format) = 'slddrw' GROUP BY material_id ) deng ON m.id = deng.material_id
WHERE m.material_code LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR m.material_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR m.specification LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%'
mapper.select: ORDER BY m.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
